goal: Prevent finalizepsbt from reporting a transaction as complete when it contains invalid final scripts
Avoids returning raw transactions that fail mempool verification when inputs have corrupted script data
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with bugfix verification across multiple script types (fametrano)
Verified by testing on PKH, SH-WPKH, WPKH, and Taproot inputs (fametrano)
Approves after agreeing to address related analyzepsbt updates in a follow-up (Bicaru20)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an RPC bug where finalizepsbt claims an invalid transaction is complete
Prevents returning raw transactions that fail mempool verification due to unverified scripts
Primarily affects malformed or corrupted inputs, so the failure mode is relatively rare
